description: iTANZ Technologies Limited is a Pakistan Stock Exchange-listed software and IT services company, formerly Zahur Cotton Mills Limited. Operating since 2017, it provides digital-transformation consulting, enterprise and asset-management systems, system and data integration, analytics, business-process automation, infrastructure and platform services, and IT security. Its client base is concentrated in Australian local government, utilities, healthcare and financial services.
headOffice: Office No. 303, 3rd Floor, Emirates Tower, F-7 Markaz, Islamabad, Pakistan
